payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each possible pair (f0,f1) from the multiset, simulate the Fibonacci recurrence deterministically, using recursion with backtracking to temporarily consume elements, and track max length.
payload.rationale: The algorithm exhaustively tries all starting pairs and greedily extends the sequence using the remaining numbers, backtracking to restore counts. It uses no memoization or DP state, fitting complete search backtracking.
